Bruno Mars.text: As a child in Honolulu he was known around Hawaii for his Elvis Presley impersonation.
Bruno Mars.evidence: Raised in Honolulu, Mars gained recognition in Hawaii as a child for his impersonation of Elvis Presley, before moving to Los Angeles in 2003 to pursue a musical career.

Rihanna.text: She was the first female musician to achieve billionaire status.
Rihanna.evidence: The first female musician to achieve billionaire status, Rihanna founded the nonprofit Clara Lionel Foundation, the cosmetics brand Fenty Beauty, and the fashion brand Fenty under LVMH.

The Weeknd.text: Abel Tesfaye started out in 2009 by releasing music anonymously.
The Weeknd.evidence: Tesfaye began releasing music anonymously in 2009.

Justin Bieber.text: Three singles from Purpose made him the first artist ever to occupy the top three of the UK singles chart.
Justin Bieber.evidence: It yielded three US Billboard Hot 100 number-one singles: "Love Yourself", "Sorry", and "What Do You Mean?". The songs also occupied the top three of the UK singles chart, making Bieber the first artist in history to achieve this.

Taylor Swift.text: She was the first individual from the arts to be named Time Person of the Year, in 2023.
Taylor Swift.evidence: She is the first individual from the arts to be named Time Person of the Year (2023) and the youngest female inductee into the Songwriters Hall of Fame (2026).

Lady Gaga.text: "Shallow" made her the first person to win an Academy, BAFTA, Golden Globe and Grammy Award in one year.
Lady Gaga.evidence: Her contributions to the A Star Is Born soundtrack, which spawned the chart-topping single "Shallow", made her the first person to win an Academy, BAFTA, Golden Globe, and Grammy Award in one year.

Drake.text: Before music, he played Jimmy Brooks in the teen drama Degrassi: The Next Generation.
Drake.evidence: Drake first gained recognition as Jimmy Brooks in the CTV teen drama series Degrassi: The Next Generation (2001–2008) and began his music career by independently releasing the mixtapes Room for Improvement (2006), Comeback Season (2007), and So Far Gone (2009), before signing with Young Money Entertainment.

Ariana Grande.text: Her accolades include forty-one Guinness World Records.
Ariana Grande.evidence: The highest-paid female musician in 2020, her accolades include three Grammy Awards, a Brit Award, two Billboard Music Awards, three American Music Awards, forty-one Guinness World Records, and fifteen MTV Video Music Awards.

Coldplay.text: The band first went by the names Big Fat Noises and Starfish.
Coldplay.evidence: Coldplay initially went by the names Big Fat Noises and Starfish.

Bad Bunny.text: Outside of music, he occasionally performs in professional wrestling.
Bad Bunny.evidence: Outside of music, Bad Bunny occasionally performs in professional wrestling.
